# typed_bus

> TypedBus is a Ruby gem that provides an async pub/sub message bus built on the `async` gem with fiber-only concurrency. It offers named, optionally typed channels with explicit ACK/NACK delivery, dead letter queues, bounded backpressure, adaptive throttling, delivery timeouts, and per-channel statistics, all within a single Async reactor.

Key facts:

- Install with `gem "typed_bus"`; requires Ruby >= 3.2.0 and depends on `async` (~> 2.0) and `logger`.
- `TypedBus::MessageBus` is the facade: `add_channel`, `subscribe`, `publish`. Publish inside an `Async do ... end` block.
- A channel created with `type:` raises `ArgumentError` when a message of the wrong class is published.
- Every subscriber receives a `Delivery` and must call `ack!` or `nack!`. A delivery that is neither acked nor nacked before its `timeout` is auto-nacked; nacked and timed-out deliveries go to the channel's dead letter queue.
- `max_pending:` bounds unresolved deliveries; publishers block when the limit is reached. `throttle:` (requires `max_pending:`) adds progressive backoff as remaining capacity falls.
- Configuration cascades Global (`TypedBus.configure`) → Bus → Channel.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/): What TypedBus is and its feature list
- [Concepts](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/concepts/): Channels, deliveries, ACK/NACK, and dead letters
- [Installation](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/getting-started/installation/): Adding the gem and requirements
- [Quick Start](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/getting-started/quick-start/): First bus, channel, subscriber, and publish
- [Configuration](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/getting-started/configuration/): Global, bus, and channel settings
- [Typed Channels](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/typed-channels/): Restricting a channel to one class
- [Delivery and Acknowledgment](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/delivery-and-ack/): ack!, nack!, and timeouts
- [Dead Letter Queues](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/dead-letter-queues/): Inspecting and draining failed deliveries
- [Backpressure](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/backpressure/): Bounding pending deliveries with max_pending
- [Adaptive Throttling](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/adaptive-throttling/): Progressive backoff as capacity fills
- [Error Handling](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/error-handling/): Subscriber exceptions and closed channels
- [Graceful Shutdown](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/guides/graceful-shutdown/): Closing channels and buses cleanly

## API

- [API Reference](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/): Index of public classes
- [MessageBus](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/message-bus/): Channel registry and publish/subscribe facade
- [Channel](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/channel/): Named pub/sub topic with type, timeout, and backpressure
- [Delivery](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/delivery/): Message envelope with ack! and nack!
- [DeliveryTracker](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/delivery-tracker/): Aggregate ACK/NACK result of one publish
- [DeadLetterQueue](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/dead-letter-queue/): Storage for nacked and timed-out deliveries
- [Configuration](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/configuration/): Global defaults and validation
- [Stats](https://madbomber.github.io/typed_bus/api/stats/): Per-channel counters

## Examples

- [01_basic_usage.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/01_basic_usage.rb): One channel, one subscriber, explicit ack
- [02_typed_channels.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/02_typed_channels.rb): Type-constrained channels with Data classes
- [04_nack_and_dead_letters.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/04_nack_and_dead_letters.rb): nack! and the dead letter queue
- [06_backpressure.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/06_backpressure.rb): Bounded channels blocking publishers
- [07_message_bus.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/07_message_bus.rb): The MessageBus facade over many channels
- [10_concurrent_pipeline.rb](https://github.com/MadBomber/typed_bus/blob/develop/examples/10_concurrent_pipeline.rb): Multi-stage pipeline combining the features
